snippet.title: Mind the Clown - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709810/Mind_the_Clown/
Take on the role of Mike, a lonely child trapped in a cursed circus within his mind. Move carefully and stay hidden to survive the demonic clown stalking you. Burn the circus posters to lift the curse and save your soul.
